response.sql: WITH budget_event_joined AS (SELECT b.*, e.type FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent > 0 AND b.amount > 0), ratio_by_line AS (SELECT type, CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL) AS ratio FROM budget_event_joined b), avg_by_type AS (SELECT type, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratio_by_line GROUP BY type), mean_of_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM avg_by_type) SELECT t.type, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - m.overall_mean AS deviation_from_mean FROM avg_by_type t CROSS JOIN mean_of_avgs m ORDER BY t.type
